# Problem, context and actor language

Execution and Operating Model documents are to establish their subject, context and motivating problem, opportunity or purpose up front, and express needs with a recognizable situation, affected participant, desired condition and motivating basis.

Use **human** and **agent** instead of personal names to identify participants in reusable document prose. Use role descriptions where needed to distinguish participants while keeping the actual project, activity and problem explicit.

Apply this authoring direction through [the document-authoring rule](../../standard/application/problem-context-and-actor-language.md). This decision accepts the authoring direction, not every substantive statement in the self-application map or the developing standard.
